title: Genesys VTT
description: Genesys VTT 0.0.153 QA: major Character Sheet visual rebuild toward the locked Genesys Fantasy target. Adds a large branded header, ornate reusable UI assets, denser three-column Summary layout, characteristic medallions, visual Wound/Strain tracks, compact quick views, redesigned Quick Dice Pool, five-pip Skills, and a Tier-lane Talent Pyramid view with ranked Talent pips and compact tier occupancy status. Preserves the verified Rule Engine, Extra Activation UX, Narrative Results Assistant, and all existing combat/initiative mechanics.
